newsitem.title: FINLAND: LANNEN TEHTAAT SEES SALES BOOST FROM SUGAR.
newsitem.headline: LANNEN TEHTAAT SEES SALES BOOST FROM SUGAR.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs group Lannen Tehtaat Oy said on Thursday sugar maker Sucros Oy, jointly owned by itself and food ingredients group Oy Cultor Ab , would take over the marketing and sales of its products.
"Lannen Tehtaat will focus on sales of sugar consumer products," it said in a statement.
The restructuring would increase Lannen TGehtaat's net sales by slightly over 100 million markka from January 1, 1998, but would not have any earnings impact, it said,
Sucros said the restructuring was part of a plan to raise competitiveness and prune out overlapping functions.
